description: Major architectural overhaul to make SecureSight fully offline (replace AWS Rekognition with local face_recognition, Supabase with SQLite, cloud storage with local filesystem, CDN models with bundled files) and add distributed multi-camera support (camera stations as browsers on school LAN departments, central server with WebSocket dashboard, camera registration and heartbeat).

userStories.title: SQLite database layer
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to replace Supabase with SQLite so that the system works fully offline without cloud database dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: New `database.py` uses sqlite3 with `recognition.db` file

Schema includes `users` table (id, name, face_encoding BLOB, image_path, role), `access_logs` table (id, user_id, status, confidence, timestamp, snapshot_path, camera_id), and `cameras` table (camera_id, department, last_heartbeat, is_online, registered_at)
All existing database.py functions reimplemented for SQLite plus new camera CRUD functions (register_camera, update_camera_heartbeat, get_all_cameras, mark_camera_offline)
DB auto-initializes schema on first run (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS)
SQLite uses WAL mode (PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL) and check_same_thread=False
Remove supabase dependency from requirements.txt
Typecheck passes
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Local filesystem storage
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to replace Supabase Storage with local filesystem so that avatar images and snapshots are stored locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Images saved to `backend/avatars/` and `backend/snapshots/` directories
FastAPI serves static files via `/avatars` and `/snapshots` mount points
Image URLs returned by API point to local static paths (e.g., `/avatars/EMP-101.jpg`)
Auto-create storage directories on startup if missing
Typecheck passes
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Local face recognition engine
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to replace AWS Rekognition with the local `face_recognition` library so that face detection and matching works offline.
acceptanceCriteria: New `face_engine.py` module with `index_face(image_bytes)` and `search_face(image_bytes)` functions
Face encodings (128-d vectors) stored as BLOB in SQLite users table
search_face returns three-way result: match dict, None (no match), or {no_face: True}
Configurable similarity threshold in config.py (default 0.6 distance)
All face_engine calls designed to be wrapped in asyncio.to_thread() for async endpoints
Remove boto3 and aws.py dependency
Update requirements.txt: add face_recognition, numpy; remove boto3
Typecheck passes
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Update app.py endpoints for offline stack
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to update the FastAPI endpoints to use the new local face engine, SQLite database, and local storage so that the full recognition flow works offline.
acceptanceCriteria: `/api/recognize` uses local face_engine.search_face() via asyncio.to_thread()
`/api/recognize` handles three cases: match found, no match (auto-register guest), no face detected (return error)
`/api/employees/add` uses local face_engine.index_face() via asyncio.to_thread()
Both endpoints save images to local filesystem instead of Supabase storage
Both endpoints log to SQLite instead of Supabase
Two concurrent /api/recognize requests do not block each other
Remove all AWS/Supabase imports from app.py
Typecheck passes
Both endpoints return correct JSON responses

userStories.title: Bundle MediaPipe models locally
userStories.description: As a user, I want MediaPipe face detection to work without internet so that the camera feed functions offline.
acceptanceCriteria: MediaPipe WASM files copied to `frontend/public/mediapipe-wasm/`
Face detection model (blaze_face_short_range.tflite) copied to `frontend/public/models/`
CameraFeed.tsx loads from local paths instead of CDN URLs
MediaPipe version pinned (no caret range) in package.json to match bundled WASM
Face detection works when browser has no internet connection
Typecheck passes
Frontend builds successfully

userStories.title: WebSocket dashboard + camera registration API
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add WebSocket broadcast, camera registration, and heartbeat endpoints so that the dashboard receives real-time updates from distributed camera stations.
acceptanceCriteria: WebSocket endpoint at /ws/dashboard with ConnectionManager for multiple subscribers
Events broadcast: recognition_result, camera_online, camera_offline, stats_update
POST /api/camera/register endpoint for camera station registration
POST /api/camera/heartbeat endpoint for online/offline tracking
Background task detects camera timeout (30s no heartbeat) and broadcasts camera_offline
Remove supabaseClient.ts and all Supabase imports from frontend
Remove @supabase/supabase-js from package.json
Add websockets to backend requirements.txt
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: App mode routing (camera station vs dashboard)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want URL-based routing so that the same React app serves as either a camera station (/camera/:id) or admin dashboard (/dashboard) depending on the URL.
acceptanceCriteria: React Router installed and configured with BrowserRouter
/camera/:cameraId renders fullscreen CameraStationPage
/dashboard and /admin/add-employee render MainApp with Sidebar
Sidebar.tsx converted from setActiveTab() to React Router Link/useNavigate
Sidebar derives active state from useLocation() instead of activeTab prop
Camera entry removed from Sidebar navigation
Shared config.ts exports API_BASE and WS_BASE
Typecheck passes
Frontend builds successfully
userStories.note: SUPERSEDES original USB camera enumeration approach

userStories.title: Camera station mode
userStories.description: As a school department operator, I want to open a browser URL on my tablet/laptop that connects to the central server and runs face recognition for my department.
acceptanceCriteria: CameraStationPage renders fullscreen CameraFeed with department identity from URL params
Camera station registers with central server on mount via POST /api/camera/register
Heartbeat sent every 10 seconds via POST /api/camera/heartbeat
CameraFeed sends camera_id with every /api/recognize request
CameraFeed uses configurable server URL from shared config.ts (not hardcoded localhost)
ResultModal auto-dismisses after 5 seconds in camera station mode
Independent isScanning/activeResults state per camera station
Typecheck passes
Frontend builds successfully
userStories.note: SUPERSEDES original multi-camera grid view approach

userStories.title: Real-time WebSocket dashboard
userStories.description: As an admin, I want the dashboard to show real-time recognition events, camera online/offline status, and live statistics via WebSocket so I can monitor all departments.
acceptanceCriteria: DashboardTab connects to /ws/dashboard via useDashboardWebSocket hook
Recognition events appear in real-time in the Recent Detections table with department source
Camera status grid shows online/offline status per department
Metric cards update in real-time from WebSocket stats_update events
WebSocket auto-reconnects on disconnect with exponential backoff (max 10 retries)
Falls back gracefully when WebSocket is unavailable
Typecheck passes
Frontend builds successfully

userStories.title: Config cleanup + deployment docs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to clean up all cloud-specific configuration and document the distributed deployment so that IT staff can set up camera stations.
acceptanceCriteria: config.py only contains local settings (DB path, storage paths, face threshold, server port)
Remove AWS and Supabase config fields from Config class
.env.example updated with only required local environment variables
docker-compose.yml updated for central server deployment with volume mounts
Backend Dockerfile updated with dlib build dependencies (cmake, build-essential)
DockerFile renamed to Dockerfile (fix capitalization)
DEPLOYMENT.md created with camera station setup instructions
requirements.txt is clean (no boto3, no supabase; has face_recognition, websockets)
package.json is clean (no @supabase/supabase-js; has react-router-dom)
Full stack starts with docker compose up

acceptanceCriteria: Root AGENTS.md reflects offline distributed architecture (central server + camera stations)
backend/AGENTS.md documents SQLite, face_recognition, WebSocket, camera APIs
frontend/AGENTS.md documents React Router, config.ts, bundled MediaPipe
frontend/src/AGENTS.md documents CameraStationPage vs MainApp routing
frontend/src/components/AGENTS.md documents CameraFeed remote server usage, Sidebar React Router integration
All parent references valid
